The ego vehicle is traveling at 30 kph (approx. 8.33 m/s). A vehicle is cutting in from the right (y=3.5m) to the ego's lane (y=0.0m) starting at x=31.6m with a velocity of 8.8 m/s. The cut-in duration is 2.05s. By the time the cutting vehicle completes its maneuver (t=2.35s from start, or t=2.05s after start), the ego vehicle will have traveled approximately 17.2m (8.33 * 2.05). The cutting vehicle will be at x = 31.6 + (8.8 * 2.05) ≈ 49.6m. The gap between the ego and the cutting vehicle is approximately 49.6 - 17.2 = 32.4m. This is a safe following distance. However, the presence of a vehicle cutting into the ego's lane requires the ego to monitor the situation closely and be prepared to adjust speed if the gap closes unexpectedly or if the cutting vehicle slows down. Action A2
